title: DPS does not appear
body:
Good evening, how are you?
I have followed the steps indicated in the script several times, however, in all attempts, the dps HUD appears but nothing is counted, either in the HUD or in the ACT application, even though the script log does not show any errors. Can you tell me what this problem could be?
author: LolisLif

comments.body:
Can you check the following:
- ACT needs to be running as administrator.
- The default B&S combat chat tab must be present, if u changed anything about it you'll have to reset all ur chat tabs.
- Make sure there's only one BNSR.exe process in your Task Manager > Details
The problem was the chat, now everything is fine, thank you very much
